issue: The 1-10 May Phase-A file records a narrower direct combat subset (Japan 8-12; Allied/Chinese 8-13), while the theater interdiction file records broader irrecoverable losses including operational/interdiction activity (Japan 12-18; Allied/Chinese 10-16).
resolution: Treat the larger theater bands as the accounting bands for 1-10 May. Treat the narrower phase bands as direct Phase-A combat subset descriptors only. DO NOT add the two bands together.
